about_short_description.short_description: Demand Curve designs courses for startups.

product.name: Growth Program
product.description: A self-paced online course that teaches startup founders and marketers how to build and scale a growth engine using proven marketing frameworks, playbooks, and templates.

product.name: Ads Management
product.description: A service that manages digital advertising campaigns for startups, including ad creative production, media buying, conversion rate optimization, and analytics reporting.

product.name: Hire Overseas Growth Talent
product.description: A matchmaking service that connects startups with vetted freelance marketers, agencies, and growth specialists from a curated network.

product.name: Growth Agency
product.description: An agency service where Demand Curve directly manages growth marketing campaigns for a limited number of startups to maintain expertise and deliver results.

product.name: Free Growth Resources
product.description: A collection of free educational materials including playbooks, blog articles, newsletters, tactics, and ad examples to help startups learn growth marketing strategies.
